top_signals.title: FAA lifts ground stop after more than four hours, but flight cancellations will stretch into the weekend
top_signals.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday afternoon, disrupting thousands of departing of flights.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
